name: filter.save
title: Save filter
summary: Save a named filter as YAML in the repository; an existing name replaces that filter.
whileReadOnlyReason: Checks the sort of the filter against the metamodel, which is missing or faulty.

description.description: What the filter is for, for people.

view.description: The view saved with the filter: `core` or a variant ID. The filter then holds only the elements that apply in this view.

where.description: Which elements the list shows; all conditions must hold. Checked as in a selection; element references are written as UUIDs. No condition: `{ all: [] }`.

sort.description: Order of element.list with this filter when its input gives no sort.

items.description: Written file, relative to the workspace root.
